name: Rafael Regalado
tagline: I build complete web applications, from the database and REST API to the interface people use.
summary: I'm a full-stack developer who works mostly with JavaScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL. I like building systems end to end: data models, secure APIs, payment and email integrations, and fast, accessible front ends without heavy frameworks.
contactBlurb: Want to work together or ask about a project? Reach me through the links below, or ask Jarvis anything about my work.

projects.name: StayEase — Hotel Booking System
projects.description: A booking and operations platform for a single hotel. Guests browse rooms, check live availability, and book and pay online or at the hotel. Receptionists run the front desk, and administrators manage rooms, reservations, payments, promotions, reviews and reports.
highlights: Race-safe availability: row locks inside a transaction, verified by tests where 8 simultaneous requests for 2 rooms yield exactly 2 bookings
Server-side sessions, CSRF tokens, role- and permission-based access, Helmet CSP, rate limiting and zod validation
PayMongo payments (GCash, Maya, cards), Brevo email and Cloudinary images, with a signed-webhook payment simulator for development
Admin KPI dashboard and 8 reports with PDF and Excel export
